concerns.text: Task T023.1 implements 'synthetic perturbations' to create 'invalid' labels. This contradicts Spec FR-003 and US-2 which mandate labels be generated by an 'independent CPU-based physics simulation engine' acting on reconstructed states. The task description explicitly replaces the required physics simulation logic with artificial data manipulation, leaving the core FR-003 requirement unimplemented.

Task T036.3.1 attempts to verify 'Latent-Space Independence' by correlating activation vectors with physical labels. However, because T023.1 generates labels via synthetic perturbation (not independent physics simulation), the independence audit logic is fundamentally flawed and cannot satisfy Spec SC-005 or Constitution Principle VI. A task exists, but it implements the wrong logic to satisfy the requirement.

Tasks T001 (Create project structure) and T003 (Configure linting) are marked as unchecked/missing in the provided text (T001 has no [X], T003 has no [X] and is listed as a task to be done). The Analyze report flags these as failed/rejected with no artifacts. Without these foundational tasks, the project structure and reproducibility gates (Constitution I) cannot be satisfied.

The Analyze report confirms these artifacts (features.npy, memory_log.json, labels.csv, metrics.json) are missing.
